name: Axiomatic Polymorph Trap
disable: DC 48 Thievery check (master) to drain the glyph's power harmlessly, or Dispel Magic (9th rank; counteract DC 42) to counteract the glyph

items.name: Axiomatic Polymorph
items.text:
Trigger A creature moves within 10 feet of the entryway to the Hall of Wonders (area N4) without speaking the passphrase ("The History and Future of Humanity") in Utopian

---
Effect Each creature within 20 feet of the door is targeted by Cursed Metamorphosis (DC 42 Will save save), except the effect transforms creatures into the form of an Arbiter aeon rather than that of an animal.

text: A Utopian glyph transforms trespassers into aeons.
